What Does The Name Alav Mean?
s: In South and Central Asian contexts, Alav can appear as a variant or derivative of Alov/Alau (fire) and is sometimes connected to devotional or honorific elements, paralleling names like Alauddin/Alā’ al-Dīn (“exaltation of the faith”). In the Caucasus, especially among Azerbaijani speakers, the closely related Alov (Алов/Əlov) literally means “flame,” reinforcing the fiery imagery.
